blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Goods travel in four main ways: by road, by sea, by air, and by rail. Each way has its own strengths. Road is flexible. Sea is cheap for long distances and large volumes. Air is fast but expensive. Rail is efficient for bulk goods on land.

Choosing the right mode is about cost, speed and distance. A small parcel across town? Road. A container of sugar across oceans? Sea. An urgent medical part abroad? Air.

The right mode fits the job. You look at what you send and how far it goes, and then you pick.

items.q: What are the four main modes of transport?
items.why: "Goods travel in four main ways: by road, by sea, by air, and by rail."

items.q: Which mode is cheap for long distances and large volumes?
items.why: "Sea is cheap for long distances and large volumes."

items.q: Why is air not used for every shipment?
items.why: "Air is fast but expensive." — por isso não serve para tudo (inferência).

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: speed is the only thing that matters
one mode is best for every job
the cheapest mode is always the right one
the best mode depends on the shipment
items.why: Inferência: "The right mode fits the job." — cada carga pede um modal.

items.q: For a small parcel across town, the text suggests…
items.why: Inferência: "A small parcel across town? Road." e "Road is flexible."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver ajudando o novo coordenador de logística. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, we have five shipments this week, so let's pick the right mode for each one.

First, the big container of sugar going to Europe. That is a large volume over a long distance, so we send it by sea. Sea is cheap, and we are not in a hurry.

Second, there is one small parcel of samples for a client in the same city. That one is easy — we send it by road. Road is flexible, and the client is close.

Third, a customer needs an urgent part, and they need it tomorrow, in another country. Speed matters more than money here, so we send it by air. Air is expensive, but it is fast.

Fourth, we have heavy machinery moving across the country, on land. For bulk goods over that kind of distance, rail is efficient. So that one goes by rail.

And the fifth? Another container of sugar. Same as the first — by sea. Most of our shipments travel by sea, because of the volume.

So, remember the simple rule: look at the volume, the distance, and how fast it must arrive. Then pick the mode.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Oliver send the big container of sugar to Europe?
items.why: "a large volume over a long distance, so we send it by sea."

items.q: Why does the urgent part go by air?
options: Because speed matters more than money
items.why: "Speed matters more than money here, so we send it by air."

items.q: How many shipments does Oliver deal with this week?
items.why: "we have five shipments this week."

items.q: Oliver suggests that most of the company's shipments travel by sea because…
options: of the large volume of goods
items.why: Inferência: "Most of our shipments travel by sea, because of the volume."

items.q: What is Oliver's main advice to the new coordinator?
options: Ask the client to decide every time
Look at volume, distance and speed, then pick
items.why: Inferência: "look at the volume, the distance, and how fast it must arrive. Then pick the mode."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We chose the best mode for the shipment." A mode is…
items.why: Mode = modal, a maneira de transportar (road, sea, air, rail).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Road transport is very ___ — the truck can go almost anywhere."
items.why: Flexible = flexível; o caminhão vai quase a qualquer lugar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sea transport is good for large ___ of sugar."
items.why: Volume = volume; o mar serve para grandes quantidades.

items.q: "We ship sugar in bulk, not in small bags." Bulk means…
items.why: Bulk = granel: grandes quantidades soltas, não empacotadas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "For a long ___, sea is cheaper than air."
items.why: Distance = distância; para longas distâncias o mar é mais barato.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em conversas sobre logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We need to send the parcel by air." This means we send it…
items.why: By air = por via aérea, de avião.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the shipping plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new delivery routes next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar/implementar algo novo.

items.q: "The parcel is on its way." This means the parcel is…
items.why: On its way = a caminho, já em trânsito.

items.q: "Please keep track of the shipment." To keep track of means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, seguir onde algo está.
